title: Live-Action Golden Kamuy: Karafuto Pursuit Arc Series Unveils More Cast
content: The official website for Golden Kamuy : Karafuto Tsuiseki-hen (Gol den Kamuy: Karafuto Pursuit Arc), the new live-action series based on Satoru Noda 's Golden Kamuy manga, unveiled two more cast members as well as a new key visual for the series on Monday.
author: ANN

title: Fool Night Manga Crosses 1 Million Copies Worldwide
content: Viz Media licensed the manga, and it describes the story: Kamiya is at the end of his rope. His mother is ill, and his job barely pays for her medication, much less food. With few options left, he considers the life-changing process of transfloration.
author: ANN

title: Ingoku Danchi: Deviant's Apartment Complex Anime's English Dub Streams on November 11
content: OceanVeil announced on Friday that it will begin streaming the English dub for Ingoku Danchi: Deviant's Apartment Complex , the short television anime of writer Sakusei Kenkyūjo and artist Yui Jōyama 's Ingoku Danchi (Indecent Apartment Complex) manga on November 11 at 11:00 p.m. EST.
author: ANN

title: 10 Best Anime to Binge on Crunchyroll in November 2026
content: The final quarter of the year has already begun, and there’s no surprise that Crunchyroll is bringing all the major series to its library. As the largest streaming platform for anime fans across the world, Crunchyroll offers an exciting range of series across all genres.
author: ComicBook

title: Live-Action My Sister's Boyfriend Film's Clip Shows Sui, Midori Rescuing Dog
content: The official website for My Sister's Boyfriend , the live-action film of Amu Meguro 's Midori Loves My Sister ( Onē-chan no Midori-kun or literally My sister's Midori-kun ) manga, presented a new clip from the film on Monday.
author: ANN

title: Solo Leveling: Ragnarok Just Made the Original Ending Tragic & Fans May Have Missed It
content: Several years after the original story’s ending, Solo Leveling: Ragnarok decides to make it more tragic than ever. The webtoon returned this month with Season 3 after more than ten months of hiatus following the lead artist JIN’s enlistment in the mandatatory military service.
author: ComicBook

title: Gen Hoshino Performs Hirayasumi TV Anime's Opening Song
content: The website for the television anime of Keigo Shinzō 's Hirayasumi manga (a co-production with Shogakukan-Shueisha Productions Co., Ltd and Production +h. ) announced on Monday that Gen Hoshino is performing the anime's opening theme song. The announcement did not reveal the song's title.
author: ANN

title: My Crush’s Crush Anime Reveals Teaser Visual, Trailer, Staff, Cast, April 2027 Premiere
content: The previously announced My Crush’s Crush anime revealed a teaser visual and a trailer on Monday. The main staff and cast and an April 2027 premiere date, have also been announced. Studio project No.9 is in charge of the animation. Kazuomi Koga is directing the anime with Yoriko Tomita handling the series scripts.
author: Anime Corner

title: Godzilla Minus Zero Earns Record $32 Million in N. American Opening Weekend
content: Godzilla Minus Zero , the new Godzilla sequel film from Godzilla Minus One 's Takashi Yamazaki , earned an estimated US$31.61 million at the North American box office in its opening weekend. A record 74% of that total came from premium large format screenings, with 40% or US$12 million from IMAX screenings.
author: ANN

title: Netflix’s Most Romantic Christmas Episode of 2026 Is Already Here
content: An ongoing anime currently airing on Netflix has just delivered its most perfect Christmas-themed romantic episode of 2026, and it will be very hard to top anytime soon. As a streaming platform, Netflix has a knack for delivering series that perfectly match the theme of the season.
author: ComicBook
